description.text: Teaching ObjectivesAfter graduation you will be equipped the knowledge of advanced technology and engineering .You can also be engaged in petroleum engineering design, operation and construction, production and management, scientific development and applied researchMain coursesOil and Gas Well Engineering, Oil and Gas Development Engineering; Advanced Math, Physics, Program Design Language, Chemistry, Oil Field Chemistry, Fluid Mechanics, Theory Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Oil Field Development Geology, Well-drilling Engineering, Oil Production Engineering, Reservoir Engineering etc.Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Engineering.CareerSpecialize in environmental safety regulations.Move into other areas such as entrepreneurship and consulting.Sales engineering which involves the service and testing functions for various types of equipment in the industry.

duration.text: The Petroleum Engineering at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. Sponsorship CertificateYou can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: Applicants for Bachelor's Degrees Programs should be between 18-35 years old with good health. Students under 18 can also apply but they might need to find an adult(your family member, relatives or friends) living in China, better a Chinese, as your guarantor in China before you can apply, and your guarantor will need to provide related documents like guardian letter for you to support their applications.Senior High school certificate.Applicants should be In good health condition, in accordance with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the Ministry of Education, China.Applicants should have good moral character and discipline towards the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and the university.IELTS or TOFEL certificate is required to prove your English ability if you didn't take those tests you can also provide other certificates like the certificate that proves you were taught in English before. The teacher will also check your English result in your transcript or allow you to send a video to judge your English proficiency.
